comment: Targets of the external connectivity tests (D-002), used only with explicit consent (-AllowExternal). Neutral large services only. Users add their own in %LOCALAPPDATA%\TunnelEye\connectivity-targets.json (same format); the lists are joined. IPv6 targets show traffic that bypasses a tunnel carrying IPv4 only; without an IPv6 default route they fail at once. ping, trace, mtu and dns.servers take IP addresses, dns.names take host names. See docs/schema/connectivity.md.
